root_cause.text: `smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon()` reuses `work->tcon` in compound requests without verifying `tcon->t_state`, allowing a prior `SMB2_TREE_DISCONNECT` command to set the state to `TREE_DISCONNECTED` and free `share_conf`, which subsequent commands in the same compound then dereference as a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon() reuses work->tcon in compound requests without validating tcon->t_state. ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup() checks t_state == TREE_CONNECTED on the initial lookup path, but the compound reuse path bypasses this check entirely." The patch adds the check `if (work->tcon->t_state != TREE_CONNECTED) return -ENOENT;` to fix the issue. The KASAN report confirms the use-after-free of `share_conf`.
